content.overview: IDA s. 25F — Conditions precedent to retrenchment of workmen (IDA s. 25F). Complete Labour treatise with statutory deconstruction, examples, verified authorities, forum analysis and chamber drafting.
content.study:
Topic at a glance
CURRENT-LAW UPGRADE — The Industrial Relations Code, 2020 is in force from 21 November 2025. For current retrenchment, use IR Code s. 70: at least one year of continuous service, one month's notice or pay in lieu, retrenchment compensation at fifteen days' average pay for each completed year (or notified equivalent), and prescribed notice to the appropriate Government/authority. Also test IR Code ss. 71–72 (ordinary retrenchment procedure and re-employment) and, where Chapter X applies, the enhanced prior-permission regime under s. 79. IDA s. 25F is historical concordance unless the dispute falls within the applicable transition framework.

IDA s. 25F — Conditions precedent to retrenchment of workmen (IDA s. 25F) is a registered section in Labour & Industrial Law. IDA s. 25F — Conditions precedent to retrenchment of workmen (IDA s. 25F) is governed by Industrial Relations Code, 2020 (in force from 21 November 2025); Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 and other earlier enactments are historical/concordance sources where the applicable transition regime requires them. identify the statute actually in force for the dispute, the date of termination or wage liability, the appropriate Government and the conciliation or reference stage.
